posts.title: A PHOTOGRAPH, Week FORTY-SIX, 2026
posts.description: A museum exhibition of one’s work is thrilling. One’s imagination can also create thrilling feelings. So, I have created my own “Museum Installations,” images as inventions of my imagination. Fictions, not composed with intent to deceive anyone. Personal thrills. _____________________________________ I would appreciate your sharing this work. howardschatz@howardschatz.com Click to follow HOWARD SC

posts.title: A PHOTOGRAPH, WEEK FORTY-FOUR, 2026
posts.description: Just imagine, photographs anywhere and everywhere: streets, hotel and building lobbies, airports, train stations, sides of trucks, shop windows, store walls, hallways, atriums, restaurants. Just imagine. And imagine I did. The images composed in this video are fictions, to enjoy, not to fool. A marvelous thing imagination. _____________________________________ I would appreciate your sharing this
